description: This file contains a migration function to update user defaults keys from a legacy prefix to a new prefix within an app named OpenClaw. It defines constants for the prefix strings and a function that iterates over stored user defaults, renaming keys with the legacy prefix to the new prefix if they are not already set.

methods.name: migrateLegacyDefaults
methods.description: Migrates user default keys from a legacy prefix to a new prefix by iterating over existing defaults and updating keys if necessary.
